technical.summary: Short-term bullish structure (SMA golden cross, three white soldiers) conflicts with intermediate weakness (below 50-day MA, below cloud, negative CMF); overbought oscillators suggest limited upside before pullback.

fundamental.summary: QQQ shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest as of 2022-07-07.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (29 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (148+ days old) and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (357.28), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent NFP event create severely adverse macro conditions for technology equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 9/21 golden cross and three white soldiers provide short-term bullish structure with supertrend confirmation, and extreme fear (VIX crisis) creates contrarian buy opportunity near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below 50-day MA and Ichimoku cloud with negative CMF (distribution), overbought oscillators signal imminent pullback, macro environment is severely adverse (VIX 357, rising dollar, flat yield curve), and NFP event adds execution risk.
